context: A uni student interviews a retired public-health nurse
purpose: Teach: 干渉/内面/摩擦/葛藤/量的/見地/末期/糖尿

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 長年、糖尿予防の現場に携わってこられたんですよね。
lines.en: You've been working in diabetes prevention for a long time, haven't you?
lines.style: Respectful, genuine curiosity. Soft opening. Lean forward slightly in posture. Careful not to presume — the rising inflection of a real question, not flattery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ。末期化を防ぐ見地から、何度も家庭訪問したよ。
lines.en: Yes. I did many home visits to prevent the disease from progressing.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recall. Each phrase deliberate and weighted. Long pause before speaking — drawing from forty years back. Voice steady but with the grain of memory in it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんの内面、葛藤を抱える方も多かったですか。
lines.en: Many patients were carrying inner conflicts, weren't they?
lines.style: Gentle probe, not pressing. Soft attack on the opening. Slight lift at the end — inviting him to expand. Respectful silence underneath the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 多かったね。地域社会との摩擦も度々あった。
lines.en: Many, yes. There was friction with the local community too, more than once.
lines.style: Accepting sadness. No bitterness — just the weight of what was. Slower pace on the second sentence. Slight trailing-off, like he's still thinking about those moments.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 量的なデータ収集、当時も行われていましたか。
lines.en: Were they collecting quantitative data back then as well?
lines.style: Shift to practical interest. Brighter, more technical tone. Lean back slightly — moving from the personal to the procedural. Genuine intellectual curiosity, no judgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 始まったばかりだった。外部の干渉は最小限にして進めたよ。
lines.en: It was just beginning. We kept external interference to a minimum.
lines.style: Calm authority. Final word has weight — a decision made and held. Slightly slower pace. The tone of someone who chose his path and would make the same choice again. Small satisfied pause at the end.
